summary: The explicit result contains A permutations of length n, giving an output-size lower bound of Omega(A n), and the accepted reference constructs exactly those valid paths.

optimality.argument: Every valid answer must materialize A distinct arrays containing n integers each. The reference prunes parity-invalid prefixes and copies one length-n path for each valid permutation, matching that unavoidable output work.

replacement_checks.evidence: Returning A explicit permutations of length n requires writing A n integer positions, so no implementation can run in o(A n) time under the ordinary materialized-array model.
The accepted search visits only alternating prefixes and performs O(n) path-copy work for each of the A leaves; its prefix-tree work is bounded by the same output term.
Authored cases cover n from 1 through 5, and the certificate regression checks ordering, uniqueness, parity, membership, and the exact combinatorial answer count through the maximum n = 10.
